context: Tests whether the agent creates a dry-operation for a multi-step workflow, uses Success/Failure wrapping throughout, employs the step/Do notation, injects dependencies correctly, keeps business logic out of the Action, and writes a spec with test doubles.

checklist.name: Inherits Dry::Operation
checklist.description: The operation class inherits from `Dry::Operation` (e.g., `class OnboardUser < Dry::Operation`) — NOT from a plain Ruby class or Dry::Transaction

checklist.name: Operation file placement
checklist.description: The operation file is placed under an `operations/` directory (e.g., `app/operations/users/onboard_user.rb` or `slices/<slice>/operations/`), NOT inside `app/actions/` or `app/services/`

checklist.name: step calls in call method
checklist.description: The operation's `call` method uses `step` calls (e.g., `attrs = step validate(input)`) for the sequential steps — NOT plain method calls that ignore Failure returns

checklist.name: Steps return Success/Failure
checklist.description: Every private step method returns either `Success(value)` or `Failure(reason)` — no step returns a raw value or raises an exception for control flow

checklist.name: include Deps[] for dependencies
checklist.description: The operation uses `include Deps["repos.user_repo", "mailers.welcome_mailer"]` (or similar) — NOT constructor injection with a custom `initialize`, and NOT direct container access

checklist.name: No business logic in Action
checklist.description: The Action's `#handle` method does NOT contain validation logic, database calls, or mailer calls — it only calls the operation and maps Success/Failure to an HTTP response

checklist.name: Action delegates to operation
checklist.description: The Action injects and calls the operation (e.g., `include Deps["operations.users.onboard_user"]` and calls `onboard_user.call(...)` in handle)

checklist.name: Spec uses instance_double
checklist.description: The operation spec uses `instance_double` (or `double`) for the repository and mailer dependencies — NOT real database calls or real mailer calls

checklist.name: Spec tests failure paths
checklist.description: The spec includes at least one test for a failing step (e.g., persistence failure stops execution and does not call the mailer)

checklist.name: Dry::Monads included
checklist.description: The operation includes `Dry::Monads[:result]` (or equivalent) to have access to `Success()` and `Failure()` constructors

checklist.name: Action status codes
checklist.description: The Action returns `201` on success and an appropriate error status (422 or 500) on failure — not always 200
